Ultra-absorbent fibers soak up spills to protect surfaces from wines, tomato-based sauces and other discoloring beverages and foods. Our tablecloth is stain- and wrinkle-resistant for easy care. Machine-wash and tumble-dry the Tablecloth, and then put it right back into use without ironing.
